protocol.status: Design frozen before candidate compilation, rendering or scoring

render.chorus: Frozen Recorded mode; epoch=-32/48000 seconds for every scenario, not remapped or fitted

timing_and_metric.note_mapping: on=round(48000*(offset+scale*source_start)); gate=round(48000*scale*source_gate); off=on+gate. This separate gate rounding exactly preserves the established baseline; it can differ by one sample from rounding mapped source end.
timing_and_metric.program_mapping: All100 inferred program changes use round(48000*(offset+scale*timeline.midi_start_seconds)). The old timeline audio_start_seconds is not reused for corrected maps. Bar-based program inference remains an assumption, not measured MIDI command time.
timing_and_metric.event_order: Sort by frame, then patch, old off, new on; preserve source-file order within each category. Patch changes preserve existing held/release voices.
timing_and_metric.score_windows: Exactly the100 prior v4 absolute recording-time windows, unchanged for every map/model. No moved or reselected windows.
timing_and_metric.metric: Unchanged frozen stereo_metrics.py: one stereo-pair RMS normalization;64 bands80-14000Hz;STFT512/2048/8192. No local or per-model timing, phase, pitch, frequency or gain optimization beyond established pair RMS normalization.

protocol.unchanged_controls: Raw33 factory bank, operator DT/ratios/envelopes, internal continuous LFO, Recorded chorus, analog circuit,12 voices,32-frame delay and epoch correction. No bend/fine tune, added noise, envelope/Reverb hypothesis or control fitting.
protocol.candidate_frequency: Audited whole FNUM commands; floor(FNUM*2^(block-3))*5500000/(6*2^24). Downstream floor/timebase remain behavioral hypotheses. No fitted per-unit clock is shipped.

producer_check.source_rows: all63 retained; same62 accepted by prior source eligibility
producer_check.nuisance: Reuse exact prior per-pack candidate cents offsets for both estimators; never refit
producer_check.scope: Posthoc reused four pitch classes, not a fresh holdout or independent unit count

gates.external_gates: CPU, wrapper, packaging, native API and exhaustive command helper validation are separately audited and must not be inferred from audio.

protocol.analysis: Keep all100 per-preset scores and signed deltas for all4 maps, all four mixed metrics, regressions and focus65/93/97. No selection of map, window, estimator or parameter from results.
protocol.audition: For each focus/window/map: hardware then Equal then Original, 250ms gaps, one RMS scalar per stereo model pair, common safety scalar per focus across all maps/models. No independent channel gain, EQ, timing or pitch fit. Keep local media only.
protocol.storage: Delete only newly rendered Equal temporary WAV after complete historical hash equality. Retain4 Original WAVs and local clips; new WAV bytes <500000000; never delete historical files.
limitations: The4 maps and all100 windows were already observed;3 alternative maps previously failed timing adoption and remain scenarios.
Source MIDI identity, observed c.00 continuity and inferred program times remain conditional.
No new fit, note remap, gate retiming, per-patch correction or artificial noise. Audio scores cannot establish native phase width, divider or envelope law.

command_helper_gate.scope: Separate compiled helper versus the previously ROM-verified functional command model; no new firmware execution in this benchmark

external_cpu_wrapper_packaging_gates: Pending separate independent validation; no automatic adoption here

interpretation.adoption_authority: Separate root decision; this report does not itself change defaults or approve packaging.
interpretation.pitch_evidence: Verified firmware command values; downstream floor/grid remains behavioral. Existing four producer classes reproduce prior fixed-nuisance residuals without new tuning; reused data, not a fresh holdout.
interpretation.recording_result: Tiny all100 joint-band improvements across4maps, but both aggregate STFT metrics worsen on eachmap. Nearly half of presets have band regressions; every row retained.
interpretation.raw_audio: Float32 full renders are finite, unnormalized masterGain1 and limiteroff, with peaks above1; only audition files are safety-scaled to peak<=.9.
interpretation.unchanged: No new oscillator envelope, noise, voice allocation, effect, patch mapping or source timing fit.

publication_scope: Original recordings and rendered media remain local ignored artifacts; no ROM/media is redistributed.
